YOUR DATA, EXPLAINED

Privacy at ClipNest

This notice describes the private beta. Public registration remains closed while the operator confirms the public contact, launch markets and final terms.

What the service keeps

Your email address, a password hash, sign-in sessions, verification and recovery requests, download history and allowance records. Submitted video links and the selected quality are kept to prepare your request. Files are temporary. Operational logs record request IDs, paths, status and timing; they do not intentionally record passwords, request bodies or download-link tokens.

Retention and deletion

  • Prepared files are available for 30 minutes. Cleanup normally runs each minute. Access stops at expiry even if deletion is delayed.
  • Video-quality results are temporary, normally ten minutes. Failed and completed requests stay in history for up to 30 days.
  • Security audit records are retained for up to 90 days. Session duration is normally 24 hours. Expired rate-limit records are removed within about ten minutes.
  • Recovery links expire in 30 minutes, verification links in 60 minutes and invitations in seven days. Encrypted outgoing messages are cleared after sending or expiry; delivery records are removed after seven days.

Account settings lets you export your account data or close the account after confirming your password. Closure revokes sessions, cancels requests, anonymizes the email and schedules prepared-file deletion. Personal history is removed as cleanup completes. The remaining anonymized account record and audit records follow the audit retention window. Database backups can retain earlier records for up to seven days and are not used to restore a closed account to active service.

Infrastructure and browser storage

The planned production deployment uses AWS for the database, temporary files, email and delivery. YouTube receives requests to obtain the video and may receive your IP address when your browser loads a thumbnail. Your browser stores preferences and the active request; the development preview also keeps local history. Account sessions use a necessary HTTP-only cookie. No advertising or marketing analytics are included.

Your choices and contact

You control whether to submit a link and can cancel a running request. Save a file before its expiry. For privacy or deletion questions in the private beta, contact the person who invited you through the same channel. A public operator identity and contact must be published before public registration opens.

Retention values shown above use the connected service when available; otherwise the release defaults are shown. Last updated 22 October 2026.
